Sources are in `sources/` unless marked eval-by-method.

| Before scoring: target, vintages, holdout, strata, baseline | 10 rules; vignette plan §1 | | core | core | 2 |

## Gaps

- The experimental design side is thin across all sources. Target informativeness (item discrimination) is the main lead.
- The theory paper and the workflow paper both describe the ladder. One owns it, the other cites it.

## Shared simulator

`sim/` serves three outputs: the theory paper's scenarios, the vignette's example data (open question 1 in the vignette plan), and course exercises.
Random target choice (`lambda = 0`) gives an experimental set-up; choice that depends on difficulty (`lambda > 0`) gives an observational one.
